data.title: 薇尔莉特 · 莱丁海岬的白伞微风
data.action: 双手轻握金属雕花白色遮阳伞的伞柄，静静伫立在临海花阶上，湛蓝眼眸如澄澈天空般凝视远方波涛，缎带束起的金发在海风中起舞，身姿挺拔如军人般端庄，神情纯净而动人
data.location: 莱丁港俯瞰碧蓝海平面的白石悬崖花阶
data.lighting: 清晨澄澈无暇的日光穿透白伞薄纱，海面闪烁着蓝宝石般的波光
data.mood: 典雅纯净、庄重深情、如画般唯美
data.description: 莱丁港花开遍地的临海悬崖。薇尔莉特·伊芙加登身着自动手记人偶普鲁士蓝蕾丝古典泳裙，双手撑起精巧的白蕾丝阳伞。金发随海风翻飞，胸前的翡翠胸针在晨曦中熠熠生辉。她静静凝视着蔚蓝无际的波涛，身姿挺拔而优雅，宛如一幅定格在时光中的永恒油画。
data.promptProse: Framed on a flower-lined seaside cliff staircase overlooking the sunlit morning ocean, Violet holds a delicate white lace sun parasol with upright grace as coastal breezes lift her hair and ribbons.
data.animaCaption: Standing poised along the blooming stone cliff stairs above a sunlit sapphire sea holding an ornate white lace parasol, she gazes calmly over the horizon in a classical Prussian-blue lace corset swimdress pinned with her emerald brooch.
data.nsfwProse: She wears a regal Prussian-blue Victorian corset swimdress finished with pleated alabaster lace hems and an ornamental emerald brooch at the sweetheart neckline.
